description: eprostor.gov.si: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eprostor.gov.si. Coverage: the area served by eprostor.gov.si. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Železniški odseki - ATOM spletna storitev prenosa podatkov; Cestni odseki - ATOM spletna storitev prenosa podatkov; Letališča - ATOM spletna storitev prenosa podatkov. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
